blogs.title: The Normal Brain MRI: When to Keep Searching for Neuro-Behçet's
blogs.description: A dive into the diagnostic pitfall of relying solely on neuroimaging. We analyze how acute neuro-Behçet's disease can present as aseptic meningitis without parenchymal lesions, meaning a 'clean' MRI does not rule out a critical CNS inflammatory process.

blogs.title: Hiccups and Hyponatremia: The Unlikely Clues to Neuroinflammation
blogs.description: An exploration of the 'hidden' clinical markers of severe SIADH. We discuss the association between persistent hiccups and CNS-driven hyponatremia, as well as the overlooked complication of rhabdomyolysis in the setting of profound sodium depletion.

blogs.title: Cytokines and Water: The Pathophysiologic Link Between Neuro-BD and SIADH
blogs.description: Moving beyond the symptoms to the mechanism. This post examines the role of proinflammatory cytokines, specifically IL-6, in driving the inappropriate secretion of antidiuretic hormone during acute neuro-inflammatory episodes.

blogs.title: Colchicine Monotherapy in Neuro-BD: Challenging the Steroid Paradigm
blogs.description: Corticosteroids are the gold standard for acute neuro-BD, but this case saw success with colchicine alone. We discuss the evidence for colchicine's anti-inflammatory effects and consider whether it can be a viable alternative when steroids are contraindicated.

blogs.title: Breaking the Timeline: Concurrent Systemic and Neurological Behçet's
blogs.description: Traditionally, neurological involvement in Behçet's appears years after the initial diagnosis. We discuss the clinical significance of concurrent presentation and how to maintain a high index of suspicion when mucocutaneous lesions overlap with non-specific CNS symptoms.
